correctedCoordinates.site: Riverside Park / Urban Ecology Center canoe launch
correctedCoordinates.reason: The old coordinate represented the park/branch area and sat about 621 feet from mapped water. The Milwaukee Riverkeeper trail map publishes GPS for a concrete ramp at Riverside Park; Milwaukee County independently designates the East Bank launch, and the Urban Ecology Center documents the path from the parking lot to the launch.

siteDecisions.site: Polaris Bridge Parking Area / Hudson River hand launch carry
siteDecisions.finding: NYSDEC publishes the parking coordinate and says the hand launch is downstream of the bridge after a 0.3-mile carry. The mapped offset is expected for the parking anchor; keep the route point as a carry-site anchor and identify the hand launch separately.

siteDecisions.site: County Highway K public canoe-access anchor
siteDecisions.finding: Portage County confirms a small county highway right-of-way used for canoe access at the Plover River crossing. It does not publish a surveyed point or parking layout, so retain the bridge-area coordinate with lawful parking and carry cautions.

siteDecisions.site: NYSDEC Fish Creek WMA Pope Mills / Route 58 access (0.8-mile hand carry)
siteDecisions.finding: NYSDEC confirms a five-car hand-launch access with a 0.8-mile carry to Fish Creek. The stored point identifies the access/carry site, not the water edge; preserve the carry distance and the distinct Route 184 access.

siteDecisions.site: Sheep Crossing RAP access-site anchor (launch edge unverified)
siteDecisions.finding: The Friends of the Verde River paddle map lists Sheep Crossing at the stored coordinate and marks it as a difficult put-in requiring a long boat haul. Retain it as a published access anchor; do not describe it as a maintained ramp or exact shoreline point.

Minnesota DNR identifies Johnson Landing as a carry-in at Big Fork River Mile 67.5 and names it as a public day-trip put-in. The DNR page/map does not give a surveyed GPS point, so retain the mapped site anchor and verify the river trail on site.

siteDecisions.site: NYSDEC Carmans River hand-launch access (300-yard carry)
siteDecisions.finding: NYSDEC publishes this site coordinate, ten-car parking, a 300-yard carry, electric-motor restriction, and cooperative access through Wertheim National Wildlife Refuge. The current point is the access anchor, not a wet-edge fix.

siteDecisions.site: Manton Avenue / Aleppo Street small-boat-launch access area
siteDecisions.finding: RIDOT identifies a small boat launch for the Woonasquatucket River at the Aleppo Street trail start and lists Aleppo Street among public parking directions. It does not publish a launch GPS, so retain the local area anchor. One dependent route was already withheld for a separate unresolved issue; that hold remains.

siteDecisions.site: Skidmore Drive RAP access area (river about 150 yards down trail)
siteDecisions.finding: The Friends of the Verde River map publishes the access-site coordinate. The Forest Service-hosted paddle guide says the river is about 150 yards down the trail; the Forest Service site description calls it pedestrian access with no developed boat launch. Retain only as a carry-in RAP, not a ramp.

siteDecisions.site: Perception Park riverside campground access area
siteDecisions.finding: The Forest Service campground record confirms the campground sits beside the South Fork Ogden River and has river recreation and a riverside trail, but it does not designate a paddlecraft launch. Keep the point as an intermediate campground/access-area marker, not an endpoint launch.

syasFollowUp.reason: The Monroe route now has one continuous network-traced Loup River line with a 193 ft maximum endpoint snap. Columbus and ADM only produced disconnected named-flowline fallback segments with a 55,652 ft maximum snap, so they remain withheld.

reopenWhen: Recheck the parking/carry path and exact landing for access anchors before upgrading them to water-entry points. Revisit the two withheld Syas routes after the correct connected Loup River reach can be generated from the verified Syas launch.
